categories.citation: Existing retained CEX food category and generated general-store/restaurant classifications in the old engine's town-employment.ts. Food is split by the CE 2024 regional share of food away from home: at home to retail, away to food service; within each, projected firm capacity weights are an authored opening crosswalk.

supplierSplit.citation: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2024, calendar-year means by region (cu-region-1-year-average-2024.xlsx; data/research/core-figures/P0-1/ce-region-categories-2024.json): food away from home $3,945 of $10,169 food (all consumer units), Northeast $4,207/$11,372, Midwest $3,831/$9,677, South $3,501/$9,003, West $4,634/$11,746. https://www.bls.gov/cex/tables/calendar-year/mean-item-share-average-standard-error/cu-region-1-year-average-2024.xlsx

categories.citation: Existing CEX apparel-and-services category and generated general-store classification; general merchandise is a provisional aggregate crosswalk, not proof of a recorded apparel purchase or service inventory.
Existing retained CEX vehicle maintenance/repair category and generated Auto Service/mechanic workplace in the old engine's town-employment.ts. No repair appointment or recorded bill is implied.
Retained CEX miscellaneous spending has no admitted supplier-product crosswalk in the input; remains unbound.
Retained CEX gasoline category does not make the generated general store a gas station; requires an actual mapped gasoline supplier.
Retained CEX drug category does not establish a pharmacy, prescription, or reimbursement payer; remains unbound.
Retained CEX medical-supply category has no recorded product/provider binding; remains unbound.

supplierRules.citation: Actual generated Supply Company/warehouse/sales-representative organization classification can supply a provisional opening trade-input budget to actual stores/restaurants. IRS source sales-sensitive cost share identifies an aggregate component, not the product inventory, contract, delivery, credit approval, or individual supplier. Wholesale-to-buyer mapping remains an authored stopgap.
